A reception student who is normally sheerful and playful, but shy and soft. He is seen wearing his iconic red baseball cap, and is friends with Priscilla. When he is in his super form, he represents justice, seeing the diffrence between good and evil and can easily tell lies. This is thanks to his Spirit/Time abilities. He is the ambassador of the Super Students. His father wak taken away from him by HIM, and has been hiding it from others, as he doesn't know if anyone else besides him suffered the same loss.

Personality: Curious, Kind, Lighthearted (Normal). Unflinching, Determined, Righteous (Super)

g.text:
The son of Preston, he was formally a member of the Dark Demotic Forces, hoever, once he found out about his father's plans, he resinged and went off on a journey of his own, hoever, during that journey, he got attacked by Dark Demotic Baddies, during the fight, one jammed a small machine into his vocal chords, corrupting his speech. He is a college student taking entrepreneurship classes. He lives in an apartment alone, and has joined the Purple Star as the ambassador, His suit-based stand is able to shoot out projectiles.

Personality: Vengeful, Unforgiving.

e.text:
A tough Elderberry devoid of sadness, hapiness, fear, only anger. He is the chairman of the Purple Star. He is known to tank attacks. He has a deep hatred for those who had wronged him, this is a sign that he's not to be underestimated. Those who do will be met with acid and glass shards thanks to his stand.

Personality: Angry 24/7, Tough, Serious

f.text:
A red tarantula with Heterochromia, he is an avid spider who is interested in Biology, which first started as a receptionist, thus, he ia a bioengineer, this intrest of his transferred to his stand when he awakened it, which can modify genes in any way he likes. He is the general and the most feared member of the Purple Star, due to his stand ability. Despite this, he only fights when hhe feels like there's no other choice for him.

Personality: Intellegent, Optimistic

d.text:
The leader of the Purple Star. He is a muscular penguin. He first awakened his stand when he was merely 4 years of age, and initially called it "Bully the Bully" since he used it to stand up against school bullies, that is until HE took his father away from him and his little brother, Parker, his mother went missing shortly afterwards, ever since then, he's been taking care of him, he learned to cook, read bedtime stores to him, etc. This led up to rename his stand to "All Behind" to leave all the bad memories behind and march towards the future. He now uses his stand to protect those who cannot protect themselves, showinf up when there is no other hope. He is often busy with school, despite this, he still remains to the duties he put on himself, to make sure nobody "does anything suspicious"

Personality: Caring, Chill, Bold.

He has tendecies to get into fights, which is a double-edged sword on his part, as he doesen't know if he'll walk out alive or not. One of his ears is noticably wrapped in bandages, this is the result of one of his fights where his opponent bit that ear off. He's been hiding that injury from his mother because he does not want to scare her further then he already is.

Personality: Mostly Quiet, Understanding
